name: "Snake" Ham & Cheese Sandwiches with Sweet Carrot Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: TO MAKE THE CARROT SLAW: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, vinegar, maple syrup, poppy seeds, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tsp pure maple syrup
2 tsp poppy seeds
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots. Using the vegetable peeler, peel a long, thin strip off of one carrot and set aside to make the "tongue." Coarsely grate remaining carrots, then add to the bowl with dressing. Stir to combine the slaw and set aside.
TO ASSEMBLE THE SANDWICHES: Split the baguette in half lengthwise (cutting through it horizontally). Spread the top half of the baguette with mayo and set aside.
Layer the bottom half of the baguette with carrot slaw, ham, and cheese. Close with the top half of the baguette. Cut baguette crosswise into 2-inch wide sandwiches.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g deli ham, sliced
10 slice Muenster cheese, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Separate lettuce into leaves. Arrange leaves on a platter as the base for your "snake." Arrange sandwiches on top of the lettuce, so that they are touching in a curvy "S" shape to create your "snake."
Cut a "V" out of one end of your carrot tongue. Insert this into the "mouth" of your snake. Add olive slices for "eyes."
